title: cytisus hirsutus subsp. ciliatus
intro: Cytisus hirsutus subsp. ciliatus, commonly known as Scotch broom, is a flowering plant species native to the Mediterranean region. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions due to its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Cytisus hirsutus subsp. ciliatus include its ability to reduce pain, inflammation, and fever, as well as its role in improving cardiovascular and respiratory health. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
